Author: NearVoice contributors; original by Ricimon
Name: NearVoice
Description: Automatic world/map proximity voice. /yakin opens the panel. Requires original ProximityVoiceChat local service settings.

Author: XeldarAlz; local Discord adaptation
Name: Aethr App (local Discord)
Punchline: Your existing phone interface with your Discord friends.
Description: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.

Author: YF
Name: Musical Guide (local camera R8)
Description: Local camera R8: steady first-person eye, per-mount seat offsets and optional physical head tracking. NearFace 0.2.5 provides one webcam for facial expressions and head pose; optional OpenTrack loopback input. Use /mguide; turn MouseLock off for head tracking. Existing settings and the R7 near-fog correction are retained. Update and fully restart FFXIV. Experimental preview; physical webcam and native game acceptance remain pending.
Punchline: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.

Author: Risa and Contributors
Name: Customize+ (local NearFace fork)
Punchline: Customize your character beyond FFXIV's limitations.
Description: Local experimental fork of Customize+ 2.2.1.3. Original profiles remain active; optional local face/head layers compose inside the existing render boundary. Not an official Aether Tools release. Native visual calibration is required.

Author: NearFace contributors
Name: NearFace Local Controls (prototype)
Description: NearFace 0.2.5: one explicitly started webcam supplies local facial coefficients and head pose for Musical Guide R8. Fit checks, bounded filtering, fresh ordered input and explicit loss/reacquisition improve stability. /nearface opens controls; /mguide can start both webcam and camera tracking. Nothing opens the webcam automatically. Facial components remain opt-in and need sculpt calibration. Local numeric data only; no image recording or other-player synchronization.
Punchline: Local face controls and read-only bone inventory for the matching C+ fork.
